source.subject: self
source.sourceText: (baseline — Cantankerous Keepers is itself a permanent on your battlefield, no special ability text)
When this creature enters, mill four cards, then put all Elf cards from among them into your hand.

sink.sourceText: Mill four cards, then put all Elf cards from among them into your hand (needs Elf cards in library to find).
Reads the just-milled cards (now in your graveyard) to find the Elves among them.
